description: A Java class that wraps Android's native Log utility to implement a custom logging node with chainable output, facilitating flexible log handling within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class implementing LogNode that forwards log messages to Android's Log and then to the next node in a linked chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional exception, and forwards the log to the next node.
